page.layout: One page of text, centred and full width. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Below the rule, a large centred title and a black-letter question. Woodcut initial G at the start of the first paragraph. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Politica, Oeconomica, Apodemica, Polemica, Hi-storia, Jurisprudentia & Theologia, de qua vide li-bellum, quem inscripsimus Apodixin doctrinæ Ca-tholicæ.
Hæc breviter dicta sunto ad quandam præcogni-tionem artium adipiscendam: Nunc Dei auxilio, ar-tes ipsas aggrediemur.
main_text.head: GRAMMATICA TEUTONICA.
main_text.p: GRammatica Teutonica est ars purè lo-quendi Teutonicè. Die Teutsche Sprache-kunst ist eine kunst seuberlich Teutsch zu sprechen.
Etymologia est prima pars Grammaticæ, in quo de singularum vocum proprietate agitur.
Vox est nota, qua unaquæq; res vocatur.

page.notes: Woodcut G initial is decorative and joined to "Rammatica" as "GRammatica". Black-letter lines are marked with bl. The rule ornament below the first section is not transcribed. The catchword "Unde" is at the lower right. The short italic questions are treated as level 3 headings, since they stand apart from the text.
